sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: US solar inverter demand is structurally rising as grid-scale and residential installations accelerate under IRA incentives, with SEDG and ENPH leading on margin recovery.
Indonesia's nickel downstreaming and EV ecosystem buildout—anchored by VKTR's bus electrification—creates a durable local supply-chain moat, insulated from global trade friction.
Climate-tech capital rotation favors cash-generative utilities like NRG over speculative hydrogen plays, as investors price in higher-for-longer rates and project-financing discipline.
sectors.ai: Buy pullbacks in US solar names (SEDG, ENPH, RUN) and Indonesian EV/battery plays (VKTR) on policy tailwinds; US IRA clarity and Indonesia's downstream nickel mandate are the catalysts. Trim PLUG exposure on hydrogen capex risk. Watch NRG for utility-scale storage upside.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG
themes: Rupiah stability and easing inflation are boosting real household purchasing power, driving volume recovery in FMCG staples and discretionary food names.
Government social-spending programs ahead of fiscal 2025 are funneling cash transfers to lower-income cohorts, disproportionately lifting mass-market consumer goods demand.
Ongoing consolidation in Indonesian retail and food distribution is creating scale advantages for mid-caps, enabling margin expansion and faster earnings growth than large-cap peers.
sectors.ai: Buy pullbacks in mid-cap consumer names with earnings catalysts (COIN, BWPT, BOGA) while trimming large-cap staples on valuation. The sector's relative strength vs. IDX and US peers signals rotation into domestic consumption; hold WATCH bias, add on any 3-5% dip in liquid names.
